mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id FROM us_sys_user u LEFT JOIN sts_person_profile p ON p.user_id=u.user_id AND p.organization_id=#{organizationId} AND p.deleted=0 WHERE u.organization_id=#{organizationId} AND u.deleted=0 AND u.status=1
AND (u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{condition.keyword},'%') OR u.user_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{condition.keyword},'%'))
AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR,p.birth_date,#{today}) >= #{condition.minAge} AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR,p.birth_date,#{today}) <= #{condition.maxAge}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM us_sys_dept d WHERE d.dept_id=u.dept_id AND d.organization_id=#{organizationId} AND d.deleted=0 AND ( d.dept_id=#{id} OR FIND_IN_SET(#{id},d.ancestors)>0))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sts_org_user_position a JOIN sts_org_position m ON m.position_id=a.position_id AND m.organization_id=#{organizationId} AND m.deleted=0 AND m.status=1 WHERE a.user_id=u.user_id AND a.organization_id=#{organizationId} AND a.position_id IN #{id})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sts_org_user_tag a JOIN sts_org_tag m ON m.tag_id=a.tag_id AND m.organization_id=#{organizationId} AND m.deleted=0 AND m.status=1 WHERE a.user_id=u.user_id AND a.organization_id=#{organizationId} AND a.tag_id IN #{id})
AND p.gender IN #{value}
AND p.education IN #{value}
AND p.occupation LIKE CONCAT('%',#{condition.occupation},'%') AND p.major LIKE CONCAT('%',#{condition.major},'%') AND p.work_experience LIKE CONCAT('%',#{condition.workExperience},'%') AND p.specialty LIKE CONCAT('%',#{condition.specialty},'%') AND p.qualification LIKE CONCAT('%',#{condition.qualification},'%') AND p.reward_penalty_note LIKE CONCAT('%',#{condition.rewardPenaltyNote},'%') AND p.work_content LIKE CONCAT('%',#{condition.workContent},'%') AND p.work_skills LIKE CONCAT('%',#{condition.workSkills},'%')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sts_training_participant t JOIN sts_training_plan plan ON plan.training_plan_id=t.training_plan_id AND plan.organization_id=#{organizationId} AND plan.deleted=0 WHERE t.organization_id=#{organizationId} AND t.deleted=0 AND t.user_id=u.user_id AND t.participant_status!='WITHDRAWN' AND t.training_plan_id=#{condition.trainingPlanId} )
ORDER BY u.user_id

SELECT t.training_participant_id,t.training_plan_id, plan.plan_name, t.result_status, t.completed_time,t.online_hours,t.offline_hours, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(r.title ORDER BY r.reward_penalty_id SEPARATOR '；') FROM sts_training_reward_penalty r WHERE r.organization_id=#{organizationId} AND r.deleted=0 AND r.status=1 AND r.training_participant_id=t.training_participant_id) AS reward_penalty_titles FROM sts_training_participant t JOIN sts_training_plan plan ON plan.training_plan_id=t.training_plan_id AND plan.organization_id=#{organizationId} AND plan.deleted=0 WHERE t.organization_id=#{organizationId} AND t.user_id=#{userId} AND t.deleted=0 AND t.participant_status!='WITHDRAWN' ORDER BY t.training_plan_id DESC
